message.content:
This magazine cover features a green textured background resembling a chalkboard with a solid red border on the left. At the top, the large word "TEMPO" is printed in a lime-green sans-serif font. Above it, white text in three columns reads: "TEBAR DUIT KANDIDAT LEGISLATOR", "GAMANG MASYARAKAT EKONOMI ASEAN", and "INVESTIGASI: PEMERASAN CALON PNS". Below the title, the date "5-11 MEI 2014" appears.

The central illustration, drawn in a white chalk-like style, shows two large disembodied hands emerging from the top corners. These hands grip thick, twisted ropes that suspend a swing. A small child with dark hair sits on the swing, viewed from behind. The rope held by the right hand is severed, leaving a frayed gap.

Large white block letters across the center state, "TEROR PEDOFIL DI SEKOLAH". Below this, smaller lime-green text reads, "Diduga ada pelaku lain dalam kekerasan seksual di Jakarta International School." In the bottom right corner, white text includes "RP 35.000", website and ISSN details, and a black and white barcode.
